title: Six leftover migration re-export shims in features/sync/ are unused by production code and violate Rule 2's 'only providers.dart barrel' clause
why: Rule 2 states the providers.dart barrel is 'the only sanctioned re-export file. Do not add other barrel/re-export files.' These six are bare `export '...';` shims (or, for sync.dart, an empty library-only file with zero exports) left over from moves labelled W1.4/W1.7/W1.8 in their own comments. Grepping every .dart file in the repo: restore_providers.dart, device_restore_screen.dart, and sync.dart have zero importers anywhere, even in tests. merge_rules.dart, profile_scoped_preference_keys.dart, and device_restore_service.dart are imported only by test files, never by lib/ production code, which already uses the canonical core/app paths directly. sync.dart's comment additionally claims 'the legacy sync stack is being deleted in Wave 2... After deletion, sync infrastructure lives in lib/core/sync/', which is stale -- OutboxSyncWriteFacade and LocalDataUploadService are the live, current replacement and were never meant to be deleted. A developer trusting this comment or grepping 'where is merge_rules defined' gets actively misleading signal.
recommendation: Delete all six files; repoint the test files that still import the deprecated paths (merge_rules_test.dart, profile_scoped_preference_keys_test.dart, device_restore_service's story-acceptance tests) at their canonical locations, moving them to the AG-5-mirrored test path in the process.
acceptance_criteria: grep confirms zero remaining files under lib/features/sync/ that are bare export re-directs to core/ or app/.

merge_rules_test.dart and profile_scoped_preference_keys_test.dart import from lib/core/sync/merge/merge_rules.dart and lib/core/preferences/profile_scoped_preference_keys.dart respectively, at the AG-5-mirrored test path.
